Name: ENM_Husk
notes: Slow walker. Frail people (elders) are weak; strong people (workers, guards) are tough. Can rise as a Reborn.

Name: ENM_Reborn
notes: Rises from an unfinished Husk or Drowned. Tentacle lashes at 1.5 to 4 m. Never rises again.

Name: ENM_Drowned
notes: Lurks in water and grabs from the shallows. Can rise as a Reborn.

Name: ENM_Brute
notes: Armored, slow, hits hard. From Ch3.

Name: BOSS_Warden
notes: Ch3, an Annex security chief turned Brute.

Name: BOSS_Undertow
notes: Ch3 sea boss in the raft fight.
